wiki.title: Seth Rose
wiki.extract: Seth Rose is an American lawyer and politician. In 2024, he served as the president of the University of South Carolina Lettermen's Association. A former Richland County councilman (2011-2018), he is currently a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from the 72nd District, serving since 2018. He is a member of the Democratic party. Rose is a former Richland County prosecutor and the principal attorney at Seth Rose, Attorney at Law.
